messages:
noah (sales): Heads-up — TidalWorks wants a 10-day POC. They requested a dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering. Need SKU advice, region, CIDR, and a two-week cost ballpark. Target start May 20. cc @anya @sam

anya (solutions): Short q: model family and concurrency?

noah (sales): Running Raptor-70B and a 13B reranker. Typical seq 1k, some evals to 2k. Steady QPS ~5, peak ~15, concurrency goal ~40.

sam (infra): Recommendation: H100-80GB for main model. Suggested pool: reserved 5x H100 + 2x A100 for noncritical batch. Autoscale min=5 target=7 max=9. Region preference: europe-west1; fallback europe-central. Provision ETA 72-96h after quotas.

lucy (security): For peering we need their CIDR, admin list, and SIEM endpoint. mTLS for control plane, KMS integration if they want keys stored. Also DPA required before we issue scoped API keys.

noah (sales): Provisional CIDR: 10.200.0.0/22. Billing contact billing@tidalworks.ai. They prefer reserved baseline + spot for bursts. Please add a rough cost estimate for the POC.

sam (infra): Ballpark: reserved 5 H100 commit ~= $70k/mo. For the 10-day POC (min 5 active, bursts to 8 ~30% time) expect ~$35k-$42k. Spot bursts reduce cost ~15-25%. Adding exact calc to ticket.

ops-bot: Provisioning ticket PR-4998 created by sam: tidalworks-poc-hybrid-h100-a100, region=europe-west1 fallback=europe-central, ETA 72-96h. Link: https://internal.redwood/provision/PR-4998

noah (sales): Great — I'll kick off DPA and send CIDR confirmation after legal review. Blocking: PR-4998 (sam) and signed DPA.
